blockingFindings.title: Scenario validity now blocks fixtures without repair baseline
blockingFindings.issue: `RunScenarioValidityCommand.execute` now requires `flowState.repairBaseline` for every scenario-validity run and blocks with `SCENARIO_VALIDITY_BLOCKED` when it is absent. The change only updates `231-task-e2e-full-lifecycle.test.js`; any other flows or tests that construct existing flow state without a captured repair baseline will now be blocked before scenario validity can diff or run tests.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Ensure the flow initialization path that creates repair/task state always captures and persists `repairBaseline` before scenario-validity can run, and update all affected scenario-validity fixtures to exercise that production path rather than relying on ad hoc state injection.
blockingFindings.rationale: R1 makes immutable repair-baseline authority mandatory for scenario-validity. Enforcing that requirement in `run-scenario-validity.js` without wiring the required baseline into every production flow state path creates a blocking acceptance gap: valid existing lifecycle paths can fail with `REPAIR_BASELINE_REQUIRED` before evaluating scenario validity.
